description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EmailSubscriberAPI within the OrangeHRM project. It tests various API endpoints (getAll, getOne, create, update, delete) related to email subscription management in the Admin API module.

classes.name: EmailSubscriberAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the correct functionality of the EmailSubscriberAPI endpoints in the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all email subscription entries via the API.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a single email subscription entry via the API.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of a new email subscription entry via the API.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing email subscription via the API.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting an email subscription via the API.
